style_line: Flanders, Christmas 1914, a frozen winter world.

location.where_when: British front-line breastwork trench opposite Frelinghien / Christmas morning 1914

light.colour_key: cold steel-blue winter light, warm orange brazier glow at night

char_thomas_hale.name: the young British private
char_thomas_hale.description: Private Thomas Hale, a lean 20-year-old English infantryman with a pale freckled face, short sandy-brown hair, light grey eyes, a khaki 1914 soft service cap with ear flaps, khaki 1902 service-dress tunic with brass buttons, 1908 webbing, muddy puttees, a long khaki greatcoat

costumes.service: khaki soft cap, long khaki greatcoat open over the tunic, every brass tunic button in place
costumes.button_cut: khaki soft cap, long khaki greatcoat open over the tunic, the top right brass tunic button cut off

characters.action: Thomas stands at the trench ladder, his rifle leaning against the sandbags
